bio: The location in Veitsburg castle is indeed something special. Once you reach the top, not only does a magnificent view of Ravensburg await you, but also Christian Ott's ambitious, flavoursome cuisine. You can put together your own set menu from the dishes on offer – flexibility is the name of the game! You can also look forward to professional and friendly service. Tip: Make your reservation in good time – this location is not only popular with locals....
